payload.reason: The evidence indicates that a new error categorization was necessary to improve the granularity and practicality of error type evaluation in Grammatical Error Correction systems, which was not adequately addressed by previous tagsets.

claims.text: A new error scheme was designed to provide a more detailed and practical framework for error type evaluation in GEC systems, as previous tagsets did not allow for sufficient granularity.
The new error categories were developed to standardize existing GEC datasets and reduce annotator workload, which was not achievable with the Nicholls (2003) or CoNLL-2014 tagsets.
The previous tagsets failed to address certain error types effectively, such as unnecessary token errors, which limited system performance.
